note: The premise of the packet was wrong and the byte census says so. nested+11E8h is not a latched ring winner with hysteresis: it is the slot the unit's own heading falls in, recomputed at the tail of every frame-state pass by 009F28F1 and read by 009E5E90 only to compare against the bearing it is about to publish. There is no commit rule, no reject threshold and nothing else the commit writes.

validation.attribution: The gunnery census does not move, which is the correct outcome. nested+11E8h has exactly one consumer, the arm choice inside 009E5E90, which decides which way the commanded heading turns to reach the same bearing. That moves nested+120Ch, which is the whole of the heading_changes shift on two of the four ships, and stops there because ShipAiOrder::slot_to_order_ring 00825F7C is still unimplemented and the commanded heading never reaches the rudder. Ship positions are identical, so the committed slots, standoffs and every gunnery number are identical.
validation.next_input: The ring winner is genuinely slot 0 on every scan because slot+30h is NaN on every ship (measured: raw_18=6700.0 norm_2c=10.0 pen_30=-nan bear_34=0.0733 evade_38=0.25 avoid_3c=0.0). 009E7BE0 sums all five words, so every total is NaN, the strict compare at 009E7BFA never fires on an unordered pair and best_slot keeps the seed. Not the reject arm at 009E784B: tune+4h is the finite 4.0 from 0081F220. The writer is ship_ai_ring_scan_arc_score_009e6870, src/ship_ai_ring_scan.cpp line 152, native 009E6870.

follow_up_packets: ship_ai_ring_arc_score_nan: 009E6870, why slot+30h is NaN. It is now the only thing between the ring scan and a winner that is not slot 0.
ship_ai_order_ring_slot: 00825F7C, 96000 calls and still unimplemented, so nested+120Ch has no consumer and no ring result reaches the rudder.

uncertainties: The byte census cannot see a block copy over the whole nested object, which would write nested+11E8h without a literal displacement. No such copy was looked for.
The two MOVSS hits on the same displacement, 00853814 and 00854AA8, are MSubmarine fields of a different object and were not read further than their enclosing function names.
009F1BC0 between 009F2124 and 009F28B4 is still unread. The store is a join that every path reaches, but what the guarded block above it computes into nested+11DCh was not established.

The winner returned by ship_ai_approach_select_slot_009e76d0 is the ring winner. When the flag_1209 arm at 009E7C98 takes over, the native publishes the goal-derived heading instead and the winner is discarded; the census still reports it.
